title: Zuckerberg 'Personally Authorized and Encouraged' Meta's Copyright Infringement
summary: This Variety news article reports on a lawsuit alleging that Mark Zuckerberg personally authorized and encouraged Meta's AI systems to engage in copyright infringement by training on publishers' copyrighted content without permission.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing legal dispute over whether AI companies and their executives should be held personally liable for using copyrighted material to train AI models.
why_valuable: Highlights the escalating tension between AI companies and content creators, raising critical questions about executive accountability and intellectual property rights in the AI era.
